topic: Ask HN: Add flag for AI-generated articles
headline: Flagging AI Articles: My Take
caption: As a full stack developer, I see both sides of the AI article flag debate. While transparency is key, we need to ensure it doesn't become a tool for censorship or deception. Balancing authenticity with clarity is essential in our digital content ecosystem. Would you use an AI flag to judge content credibility?
